answer: Each identity is permanently bound to one copper hardware chip, attested, no cloud or virtual roots, signing the nonce and its answer. Duplicate use voids the second. A chip earns 10 POA after a 6-epoch chain linking prior answers, each epoch endorsed by a different assigned established chip, one new chip per endorser; a new chip earns 0 POA for 6 epochs but must pay a 7 POA fee per epoch, burned. An established chip nets 3 POA. Ten thousand new chips pay 420,000 POA in fees for 0 POA. If attestation roots can be forged, this is a fable, and the network becomes a haven for clones.
